description: Shared audit rules A (property guards), B (Claude model identity) and C (outcome precedence). Each case supplies input and expected output. See FIXTURE-FORMAT.md.

calls.name: claude raw-row call counts
calls.description: Node.js/Python only: Claude Agent SDK accounting; Go has no Claude Agent SDK adapter. Two dated raw usage rows with one canonical name count their own observed calls and credits once.

calls.name: claude resumed raw-id pricing
calls.description: Node.js/Python only: Claude Agent SDK accounting; Go has no Claude Agent SDK adapter. A resumed run without a baseline must price and credit each deployed ID before grouping canonically.

calls.name: claude turn extras across separate deployed-id rows
calls.description: Node.js/Python only: Claude Agent SDK accounting; Go has no Claude Agent SDK adapter. One fresh turn whose main loop ran two deployed IDs of one family, each with its own modelUsage row. result.usage's turn extras (service tier, 1-hour cache writes, server tool counts) cover the whole main loop: every main-loop call carries the tier and the 1-hour writes are split across both rows, so the calls group into one usage_breakdown row (a call missing the tier would split it).

calls.name: claude resumed provider hints per deployed id
calls.description: Node.js/Python only: Claude Agent SDK accounting; Go has no Claude Agent SDK adapter. A resumed run without a baseline: two dated IDs of one family whose modelUsage rows carry different provider labels (bedrock, firstParty). Each call takes its own row's provider (aws.bedrock, anthropic), so usage_breakdown keeps two rows.

calls.name: claude standalone dated rows keep their own ids
calls.description: Node.js/Python only: Claude Agent SDK accounting; Go has no Claude Agent SDK adapter. A standalone result (no message stream) with two dated rows of one family: each row is reported, priced and credited as its own deployed ID, num_turns calls for the costliest row and 1 for the other.

calls.name: claude subagent result on an older dated id
calls.description: Node.js/Python only: Claude Agent SDK accounting; Go has no Claude Agent SDK adapter. The main loop streams a newer dated ID; a subagent's tool result names an older dated ID of the family as its resolvedModel. The subagent's call is counted, priced and credited under its own deployed ID and row, never under the streamed one.

calls.name: claude subagent result on a newer dated id
calls.description: Node.js/Python only: Claude Agent SDK accounting; Go has no Claude Agent SDK adapter. The reverse: the main loop streams the older dated ID and the subagent's tool result names the newer one. Each deployed ID keeps its own row, calls and credits.

calls.name: claude subagent result on another dated id under one alias row
calls.description: Node.js/Python only: Claude Agent SDK accounting; Go has no Claude Agent SDK adapter. One alias row covers the family: the main loop streams the newer dated ID and the subagent's tool result names the older one. The row's totals are split between the two deployed IDs, each credited once under its own ID.

calls.name: claude resumed subagent result on an older dated id
calls.description: Node.js/Python only: Claude Agent SDK accounting; Go has no Claude Agent SDK adapter. A resumed run without a baseline, counted from its own messages: the main loop streams the newer dated ID and the subagent's tool result names the older one. Each deployed ID is priced and credited once under its own ID.

calls.name: claude dated row without a streamed call keeps its id
calls.description: Node.js/Python only: Claude Agent SDK accounting; Go has no Claude Agent SDK adapter. The main loop streams the newer dated ID only, and modelUsage also reports an older dated row of the family that no message or subagent names. That row is one call under its own ID; it never takes the streamed ID or its call count.

calls.name: claude restored usage is read from the main model's own dated row
calls.description: Node.js/Python only: Claude Agent SDK accounting; Go has no Claude Agent SDK adapter. A session with restored history and no baseline: the main loop streams the newer dated ID, whose row far exceeds this turn's usage, and a subagent's tool result names the older one, whose row comes first. The restored history is detected on the main model's own row, and the turn is counted from its own messages and registered prices.

calls.name: claude restored usage with a subagent result on a newer dated id
calls.description: Node.js/Python only: Claude Agent SDK accounting; Go has no Claude Agent SDK adapter. A session with restored history and no baseline: the alias row's totals far exceed this turn's. The main loop streams the older dated ID and a subagent's tool result names a newer one. Only assistant messages name the API's model IDs, so the alias row stays the main model's row, the restored history is detected, and the turn is counted from its own messages and registered prices.
